description.value: Mr. Mikes is a Canadian casual steakhouse chain founded in 1960, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, unpretentious setting the brand calls 'SteakhouseCasual.' The Cranbrook location on Cranbrook Street North welcomes walk-ins and reservations, and positions itself as a gathering spot for both locals and travellers. A daily happy hour and a full takeout and delivery service make it a flexible stop for cyclists needing a proper sit-down meal or a meal to go.

address.value: 1028 Cranbrook Street North, Cranbrook, BC V1C 3S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mrmikes.ca/locations/cranbrook-bc/ confirms the business is open, corroborates the OSM address (1028 Cranbrook Street North, V1C 3S3) and phone number (250-417-2542), and explicitly offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery. No cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, Wi-Fi, device charging, water refill policy—are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content. Takeout is confirmed by the 'Order for Takeout' button and text on the location page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant with confirmed contact details and active ordering options. A solid dining stop for touring cyclists in Cranbrook.
